subject: [PATCH v6 10/12] mm: handle PMD swap entry faults on swap-in

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch adds a new handler, do_huge_pmd_swap_page(), to handle PMD swap entry faults during swap-in operations. The handler resolves the entire 2 MB mapping in one shot by looking up the folio in the swap cache and allocating a PMD-order folio if necessary. It also handles cases where the folio is split or has hardware-poisoned subpages, and ensures that large-folio PTE batching is disabled for such folios. The patch mirrors the behavior of do_swap_page() at PMD granularity and restores soft_dirty and uffd_wp from the swap PMD. Additionally, it updates vmf->orig_pmd and calls wp_huge_pmd() to COW without waiting for a second fault in certain cases.
